input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES. COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: Section 7(a) caps both parties, but the basis is not 12 months' fees: Contractor's cap is only the fees paid for the particular Services under the relevant Statement of Work, which on a long or multi-SOW engagement can fall well below twelve months' fees. The only carve-out points to "PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF", which is the Independent Contractor clause, so it is a dangling reference and the Agreement contains no indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence or wilful misconduct carve-out (Section 8 confidentiality obligations sit inside the cap). That fails the fallback on material terms. We therefore target the fallback: a mutual cap of fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim, with Excluded Claims (indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence, wilful misconduct) outside the cap. The mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages in 7(b) is untouched.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at 12 months' fees and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and set it at twelve months' fees, and replaced the broken cross-reference with Excluded Claims so indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S MAXIMUM AGGREGATE LIABILITY TO THE OTHER ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR ANY STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILFUL MISCONDUCT.
